title: Class of development
note: Classes of Development Regulation 164/88 assigns the licensing decision by voltage. The voltage has not been published, so which official decides is not yet knowable.

title: Cabinet designation
note: Canadian Energy Regulator Act s.261. No criteria are published and no timeline applies. Nothing need happen before the order is made, and nothing compels it ever to be made.

title: Route selection
note: No statutory basis. The alternatives everything downstream argues about are chosen here, with no public record beyond the fieldwork file and no duty to give reasons.
